dedupe_keys.name: national broadband network service footprints nbn co march 2024

description: This dataset, supplied by NBN Co to the Australian communications department, maps the footprints of the National Broadband Network as prepared on 26 March 2024: the fixed-line footprint, where premises are served by fibre, hybrid fibre-coaxial or copper-based technologies, and the fixed-wireless footprint, where location identifiers are assigned fixed wireless as the default technology on the basis of a desktop prediction of coverage; the remainder of Australia is served by satellite. NBN Co warns that the fixed-wireless map is predicted coverage: each new connection gets a service qualification test and, where the signal is insufficient, the premises are switched to satellite, and the technology planned or delivered for a premises may change over time. Coverage: Australia, March 2024 state. Format and access: zipped shapefiles for the fixed-line and fixed-wireless footprints and a WMS service, free under CC BY 4.0 with NBN Co as copyright owner, provided as is without warranty. Caveats: footprints, not premises-level availability; the snapshot is from March 2024 and the network keeps changing. Simulation uses: which access technology serves an area, and therefore its exposure to power loss, bushfire and flood; backup options in disasters; and demand modelling for broadband. Related records: the ACCC Measuring Broadband Australia data give performance by technology, and the mobile coverage programme datasets cover mobile gaps.
